title: Binance Now Supports Tokenized RWAs as Off-Exchange Collateral
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance is expanding its institutional off-exchange settlement services by adding support for two tokenized real-world assets (RWAs):  USYC  and  cUSDO . Institutions can now use these  yield-bearing ,  tokenized stable assets  as collateral via  Banking Triparty  and  MirrorRSV , enabling secure trading on Binance while retaining off-exchange custody and optimizing capital efficiency. About Banking Triparty and MirrorRSV Banking Triparty:  Binance Banking Triparty is a custody solution modeled after TradFi that allows institutions to trade on Binance while holding their collateral securely with a  regulated third-party bank  under their own corporate account. This structure helps mitigate counterparty risk and aligns with institutional governance and compliance frameworks. MirrorRSV:  MirrorRSV is an off-exchange custody solution developed by  Ceffu , Binance’s institutional crypto custody partner. It allows users to trade on Binance while assets remain in  segregated cold wallets , fully verifiable on-chain. This gives institutions enhanced transparency and auditability while retaining access to Binance’s liquidity. About the Supported Assets USYC  USYC is the digital representation of interests in Hashnote International Short Duration Yield Fund Ltd, a tokenized money market fund (TMMF) registered in the Cayman Islands (the “Fund”). The Fund invests primarily in reverse repurchase agreements backed by U.S. government securities. It offers near-instant redemption into USDC. USYC will also be natively issued on BNB Chain, increasing its on-chain accessibility to more users. cUSDO cUSDO is a wrapped version of OpenEden OpenDollar ("USDO"), a rebasing yield-bearing stablecoin issued by OpenEden Digital, a Bermuda-licensed and regulated entity. cUSDO and USDO let holders earn yield generated from reserves backed by U.S. Treasury bills and reverse repurchase agreements. Key Benefits New RWA Support:  USYC and cUSDO — tokenized Real-World Assets can now be pledged as off-exchange collateral. Flexible Custody Options:  Choose between Banking Triparty (custody with a regulated third-party bank) or MirrorRSV (segregated cold wallets with on-chain visibility via Ceffu, Binance’s institutional custody partner). Capital Efficiency:  Use high-quality, yield-bearing assets as productive capital. Earn yield while reducing counterparty risk. Zero Service Fee Until End of 2025 To enhance accessibility to our suite of institutional-grade off-exchange settlement solutions, Binance is  waiving all service fees  for Banking Triparty and absorbing the fees for Ceffu’s off-exchange settlement solutions. This initiative provides institutions with a seamless, low-friction path to adoption. Why It Matters This integration brings real-world asset collateral into Binance’s off-exchange infrastructure, giving institutions new ways to participate in crypto markets with assets that align with traditional portfolio mandates. As demand for exposure to tokenized quality assets such as Treasury bills continues to grow, Binance is enabling institutions to go beyond holding, and start using these assets within secure, compliant capital strategies.
